notes: Level 1 now follows the story script. A far white light pulses once at the screen edge, and a pointer leads you to it. The red signal on the ridge only shows during the storm.
In level 1, each goal now shows mid-screen until you tap it, starting with "Reach the light". The floor arrows are on from the first moment.
KILN's first message in level 1 opens with its boot header, Knowledge Integration and Logistics Network. Its cloud is smaller and brighter, right beside the commander, as in levels 2 to 5.
Level 1 now has the Restart button and the level menu, like every other level.
